inv.desc_en:
Commercial premises for rent at street level on Calle Alondra, located in the Carabanchel district, an established area with constant commercial activity.
? Main features:
• Surface area: The property registry lists the premises as 43.19 square meters. The cadastre indicates 45 square meters.
• Open-plan and versatile layout
• Shop window with good visibility
• 1 bathroom with ventilation
• Additional ventilation at the rear of the premises
• At street level
• Good natural light
• Facilities in good condition

The ventilation in the bathroom and at the rear of the premises is a very important added value, ideal for activities requiring air renewal and greater comfort.

Area with shops, supermarkets, schools, and services. Good connections to the center of Madrid and nearby public transport. Metro lines L5, L6, and L10.
? Ideal for:

✔ Local convenience store
✔ Office or professional practice
✔ Beauty or wellness center
✔ Academy
✔ Investors.
